resources.string: Claude is checking spelling and grammar…
There is no text to check in this field.
Add your Claude API key first: FUTO Settings → Actions → AI check.
The API key is not valid. Check it in the AI check settings.
Too many requests right now. Try again in a minute.
No connection to Claude. Check your internet and try again.
Claude declined to check this text.
Create one at console.anthropic.com → API Keys. It is stored only on this phone.
Claude Opus 5.5 (best, about 1 cent per check)
AI check sends text to Anthropic only when you tap AI. If AI topic is on, text is also sent in the background while you type. Explanations follow the language of the text.
How much the transformer reorders swipe suggestions by the sentence. 0 = off, 0.3 = default, higher = trusts the sentence more than the swipe path.
How many words the swipe decoder returns for the transformer to choose from. 4 = FUTO default. More = finds the right word more often, but swipe can be a bit slower.
Needed for Serbian QWERTZ (with š, đ, č, ć, ž)
An extra row under the suggestions that predicts the next word from the sentence (transformer). The keyboard gets a bit taller.
Swipe the suggestions left to see more choices. Takes effect when you open the keyboard again.
Saves swipe candidates, transformer decisions and settings to a file on this phone (Android/data/…/files/swipe_log.txt). Not saved in password fields or incognito. Turn off when done.
One tap on the home screen saves the swipe log to Download/FUTO/
This launcher does not support shortcuts

How much text before the cursor the transformer reads (characters). 70 = FUTO default (about 10 words, current line only). More = it knows what you are writing about, previous lines included, but suggestions may be a little slower.
Follow the topic of what I write

Every few sentences AI reads the text in the background and lists words that are likely to come next. Those words get a boost right away when you swipe or type, with no waiting. Text is sent to Anthropic (not in password or incognito fields).
How much a topic word is pushed up among suggestions. 0.3 = gentle, 1.0 = strong.
Approx. per month at this pace: %1$s
When you tap a different suggestion after a swipe twice (e.g. Jebi → Kreni), that word comes first next time after the same previous word. Tapping the old word again undoes it.
